card.name: Inside the word exacerbation in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter B in the split-up capitalised word EXACERBATION, in boxed warnings about acute exacerbation of hepatitis B. It also fires once on a Lao script character.

modes.label: EXACERBATION in hepatitis B warning
modes.description: The B piece partway through capitalised EXACERBATION(S) in the headline warning.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Lao script character
modes.description: A single Lao letter inside a Lao-language motto, a rare unrelated case.
